name: Edi Pasalis
reason: No contact route of her own: her website (edipasalis.com) now shows only her name (a Sutra community app with no readable pages; /Contact and /services return 404), so no published email or contact form can be opened; search results quote an older contact page with an email, but it is no longer published. Her own work is also now framed as menopause coaching (her own Kripalu programme on menopause is condition-named), though her Kripalu programmes Transformation Through Transition (29 Nov to 4 Dec 2026, 19 to 21 Feb 2027), the Kripalu Silent Retreat (1 to 8 Jan 2027, with Jess Frey) and the Online Studio are current, so she could be revisited if her site publishes a contact page.
